notes: EASY TIER ONLY: queries are mechanical rephrasings of section headings/marginal notes, so lexical overlap with the gold section is built in. This tier can detect a broken retriever; it cannot bless or damn a vector index. Hand-authored adversarial items (paraphrased propositions, ambiguous legal terms, cross-reference asks, and negatives with no supporting source) must be added before the asymmetric gate's verdict means anything.
Candidate pool = slice-v1.json: every section of the 48 sampled candidate documents (16 gold + 32 pure distractors), not the full corpus; absolute recall numbers are inflated accordingly.

Gold quote = first sentence of the gold section; exactly one gold locator per item. Derivation: scripts/retrieval-gate-seed.ts (deterministic, no LLM). Identity: citation_key = citationLookupKey (Beaver port of the reference normalizer, oracle-diffed in retrievalGate.test.ts).

items.query: What does the Asia-Pacific Foundation of Canada Act say about short title?
items.gold_quote: This Act may be cited as the Asia-Pacific Foundation of Canada Act.

items.query: Under the Asia-Pacific Foundation of Canada Act, what are the rules on vice-Chairperson?
items.gold_quote: The Board may elect from among its members a Vice-Chairperson who, in the event of the absence or incapacity of the Chairperson, or if the office of Chairperson is vacant, has all the duties and functions of the Chairperson.

items.query: Where does the Asia-Pacific Foundation of Canada Act deal with committees?
items.gold_quote: The Board may appoint an Executive Committee or advisory or other committees under such terms and conditions as the Board may by by-law provide.

items.query: Where does the Motor Vehicle Fuel Consumption Standards Act deal with short title?

items.query: Under the Agricultural Research and Innovation Ontario Act, what are the rules on fiscal year?

items.query: Where does the Agricultural Research and Innovation Ontario Act deal with audits?

items.query: What does the Employee Investment Act say about permanent establishment?
items.gold_quote: In this section, *permanent establishment* has the same meaning as in the Income Tax Act.

items.query: Under the Employee Investment Act, what are the rules on the register?
items.gold_quote: The administrator must maintain a register containing the information required by subsection (3).

items.query: Where does the Employee Investment Act deal with report to administrator?

items.query: Indian Self Government Enabling Act: which provision addresses timing?
items.gold_quote:
A regulation under section 20 or 21 (1),
(a) if made before March 1 of a calendar year, may be made to apply starting with that calendar year or with the next calendar year, or
(b) if made on or after March 1 of a calendar year, may be made to apply starting with the next calendar year.

items.query: What does the Indian Self Government Enabling Act say about advisory councils?
items.gold_quote: After or in anticipation of a proclamation under section 17, the Lieutenant Governor in Council by regulation may establish an advisory council to represent all the residents of an area over which an Indian district has jurisdiction.

items.query: Under the Indian Self Government Enabling Act, what are the rules on approving officers?
items.gold_quote: A person appointed as an approving officer by an Indian district, with respect to the area over which the Indian district has jurisdiction, may exercise the jurisdiction conferred on an approving officer by the Land Title Act, by a regulation under that Act or by any other enactment.

items.query: Where does the Members' Conflict of Interest Act deal with conflict of interest prohibition?
items.gold_quote: A member must not exercise an official power or perform an official duty or function if the member has a conflict of interest or an apparent conflict of interest.

items.query: Members' Conflict of Interest Act: which provision addresses commissioner?
items.gold_quote: There must be appointed a commissioner who is an officer of the Legislative Assembly.

items.query: What does the Members' Conflict of Interest Act say about inquiry?
items.gold_quote: On receiving a request under section 19, and on giving the member concerned reasonable notice, the commissioner may conduct an inquiry.

items.query: Under the British Columbia Railway Finance Act, what are the rules on definition?
items.gold_quote: In this Act, *company* means the British Columbia Railway Company.

items.query: Where does the British Columbia Railway Finance Act deal with form of securities?
items.gold_quote: The notes, bonds, debentures and other securities authorized and issued by the company under this Act must be in a form determined by the company or by the minister as agent for the company.

items.query: British Columbia Railway Finance Act: which provision addresses continuing grant, debt charges?
items.gold_quote: The minister must in each year, on or before the fiscal year end of the company, review the debt and capital expenditures of the company and determine the amount of a grant to be paid in respect of the company's debt charges and capital expenditures.

items.query: What does the Agricultural Societies Act say about definitions?

items.query: Under the Agricultural Societies Act, what are the rules on limitation of liability of members?
items.gold_quote: A member of a society is not, in the member’s individual capacity, liable for any debt or liability of the society.

items.query: Where does the Agricultural Societies Act deal with real estate?

items.query: What does the Court of Appeal Act say about oath of office?
items.gold_quote: Each judge, before entering on the duties of that office, shall take the oath prescribed by the Oaths of Office Act before the Lieutenant Governor, the Chief Justice of Alberta or the Chief Justice of the Court of King’s Bench.

items.query: Under the Court of Appeal Act, what are the rules on personnel?
items.gold_quote: In accordance with the Public Service Act , there may be appointed Registrars, Deputy Registrars and case management officers of the Court and all other officers and employees that the business of the Court requires.

items.query: Where does the Freehold Mineral Rights Tax Act deal with liability for tax?
items.gold_quote: A tax in respect of each taxable mineral right, calculated by the Minister in accordance with the regulations, shall be paid to the Crown in right of Alberta in respect of each taxation year.

items.query: Freehold Mineral Rights Tax Act: which provision addresses powers of court?

items.query: What does the Freehold Mineral Rights Tax Act say about certificate of amount or penalty not paid?

items.query: Where does the Justice of the Peace Act deal with appointment of non-presiding justices of the peace?
